snippet.title: Join the STARSEEKER crew on June 11!
snippet.description:
STARSEEKER launches into Early Access on Steam, PS5, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch 2 on June 11: https://www.starseekergame.com/

STARSEEKER is a new game set within the Astroneer universe with a focus on discovery, cooperative expeditions, and camaraderie. Exploring deep space on the ESS Starseeker, players will need to work together with the entire crew of the space station to complete objectives that will take them further into the unknown regions of each planet. Plan and lead timed expeditions to gather resources, complete missions, and further the goals of you, your squad, and the entire station. 

Visit our website for more info: https://www.devolverdigital.com/

Subscribe for more: https://devolver.link/youtube
